desc: The all-new Simmons Pro Hunter Riflescopes offer an all-glass optical system providing crisp images in low lighting conditions with fully coated lenses and IPX7 waterproof, fog-proof and shockproof construction giving you piece of mind in the outdoors. Built with an aggressive and rugged new design including textured magnification power change ring and capped finger adjustable windage and elevation turrets. The Pro Hunter riflescopes feature a one-inch one-piece aluminum main tube with a simple, easy-to-use Simmons Truplex Reticle. All Simmons riflescopes come ready to go out of the box with included lens covers and one-inch aluminum weaver-style rings.
